corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the clear right-side horizontal stroke of 2nd-order 'ቱ' (መዋዕቱ, 'his victory' / 'ድል መንሳቱም'), which was misread as 1st-order 'ተ'.
Both visually on the page and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez 1st person plural imperfective ('ንነሥእ' = 'የምንቀበል ከሆነ'), the initial character is 6th-order 'ን', not 1st-order 'ነ'.
